channel.title: Writing on AI Products, Data and PropTech | Ahmadreza Samadi
channel.description: Articles and explainers by Ahmadreza Samadi on building AI products, AI costs and decision models, connected apps, and real estate technology.
channel.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Does Incognito actually make you invisible?
item.description: A simple gift-shopping story explains Incognito, cookies, website records, saved files and what private browsing actually hides. By Ahmadreza Samadi.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: What does Accept cookies actually mean?
item.description: The same small browser note can remember your shopping basket or help a company recognise you across websites. The choice is about what that note does.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does AI sound so confident when it is wrong?
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains confident AI mistakes with a fictional museum example, an animated film and a simple way to check claims against evidence.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does your phone stop charging at 80%?
item.description: A chosen limit, a learned routine and a heat pause can look similar. They have different triggers and different ways to resume charging.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How satellite messaging works without cell towers
item.description: How a supported phone sends texts through satellites, how the message returns to Earth, and what to check before going off-grid. By Ahmadreza Samadi.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: What AI home-value estimates miss
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains what automated home-value estimates can miss: incomplete property facts, weak comparables, uncertainty and uneven error.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Where AI should stop in real estate

item.title: Two batteries, one foldable phone: how the battery reading works
item.description: Why a foldable phone can have a battery on each side but show one charge reading. Ahmadreza Samadi explains energy-aware gauging without guessing Apple's wiring.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Humanoid robots at home: demos, shipments and autonomy
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains how to read humanoid robot claims: shipment forecasts, home robot preorders, remote assistance and evidence of useful autonomy.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How to check an image claim, AI-made or not
item.description: A practical checklist for checking an image and its claim: find the source, reverse-search it, inspect provenance signals and seek independent corroboration.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI agent safety: boundaries before actions
item.description: What changes when AI assistants can act? A practical guide to agent permissions, NVIDIA OpenShell and the Sentry reference design.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How ZIP files work: compression without losing data

item.title: How passkeys work: why Face ID is not your password
